# Test data

## `Tiny5-Regular.ttf`

The [Tiny5](https://github.com/googlefonts/tiny5) pixel font, used only by the crate's tests to
exercise the dynamic TrueType glyph atlas (`GlBackendBuilder::ttf`, issue #367). It is **not**
shipped in the published crate (the `testdata/` directory is test-only and excluded from the
package).
